Name: Strix Scarecrow
Author: Drainbran
Description:
This mod puts Strix as you basic craftable scarecrow (The one you have available after just a few days of ingame time).

Strix is the Tiefling character of Commander Holly, played as part of the Wafflecrew in the Dice, camera, Action games.


[size=4][b]Installation:
[u]
[/u][/b][/size][b][u]Backup your files before installing this mod if you ever want to use the normal scarecrow again!![/u]

[/b]1.) Download the file
2.) Put it into the folder "Tile sheets" in your Stardew Valley folder.[b][/b] Normally you should find this folder under: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\content"

Downloads.Description: Zip contains only the file to put in your game folder.
